tables.name: Expense
tables.description: How much was spent on the fortress. Modifies Furnishings; sets the castle's Curtain Wall Defenses rolls.

results.name: Paltry
results.description: The fortress was built on a shoestring budget, barely sufficient to build even the most basic and rudimentary version, possibly cutting corners by necessity. (-5 to furnishings roll)

results.name: Modest
results.description: The fortress was constructed with a small budget, enough to build something simple, but functional. (-2 to furnishings roll)

results.name: Moderate
results.description: The fortress was built with a medium budget, perhaps allowing for a small comfort or two. (+0 to furnishings roll)

results.name: Significant
results.description: The fortress was built with a large budget, allowing for high-quality materials and some luxury elements. (+2 to furnishings roll)

results.name: Extravagant
results.description: Little or no expense was spared in the construction. Materials are of top-quality, and the fortress feels grand and splendid. (+5 to furnishings roll)
